values.note: City of Wolf Lake engine: RV/electric site $30 a night; $40 on the July 3, 2027 holiday night. Tent sites $15.

fees.source: rezStream engine for Wolf Lake Campground: 'RV Site 1'-'RV Site 8' '$30.00 / night' for 2027-06-15 and 2027-04-20, '$40.00 / night' for 2027-07-03; 'Tent Site' '$15.00 / night'; prices shown 'before tax', read 2026-11-11

values.note: Eight RV/electric sites: 1-3 are 40-ft drive-through, 4-8 are 35-ft back-in; seven tent sites.

sites.source: rezStream engine unit list ('RV/Electric Campsites – Enjoy comfortable camping with our 40' drive thru RV/Electric Campsite' (RV Sites 1-3); '... our 35' back-in RV/Electric Campsite' (RV Sites 4-8); Tent Sites A-G), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: rezStream site descriptions ('Sites include RV hookup, water spigot, picnic table, and a fire ring... easy access to restrooms and showers'; tent sites 'convenient access to nearby running water, restroom facilities and campground showers') + Becker County ('showers and restroom facilities'), read 2026-11-11

booking.source: rezStream engine returns bookable RV sites with nightly prices for single 2027 nights, read 2026-11-11

note: City of Wolf Lake campground at Waterfront Park on Wolf Lake, with a swim beach, docks, pickleball and volleyball courts, playground and a rentable pavilion. --Claude
summary: rezStream engine + Becker County read: $30 RV/electric ($40 holiday), tent $15, before tax; 8 RV sites (3 x 40-ft drive-through, 5 x 35-ft back-in) + 7 tent; showers/flush/water; online booking. Amps and season not stated. Not waterfront kept (possible lakeview lead). Directory link to drop.
flags: Website: drop the directory line https://www.exploreminnesota.com/profile/city-wolf-lake-campground/3034 (Explore Minnesota listing, not the operator); keep https://guest.rezstream.com/search/wolf-lake-park-campground. No City of Wolf Lake website found; Google's listing links facebook.com/WolfLakePark.
Phone 218-538-9500 kept (Google listing). Explore Minnesota lists (218) 538-6528 as an alternate; no city page posts either.
Google Maps: 4.6 stars from 71 reviews. Municipal park; no long-stay or seasonal marketing seen on the engine.

Waterfront (kept not waterfront; possible lakeview lead): on imagery the RV loop appears to be the gravel loop at the north end of the park (~46.8132,-95.3633), its west end ~45-50 m from the Wolf Lake shore across open grass with a tree belt along the shore; which pads are which is not mapped and no site photo was seen, so no value is earned. The engine says only 'Conveniently located near the lake'.

Hookups: the engine says 'RV hookup' with a 'water spigot' on each RV site but gives no amperage; hookups left as stored (water true from the old note; electric unset). Becker County's page still says 'four sites with electric hookups' (stale; the engine sells eight).
Season not stated: the engine priced a January 2027 night too, so its calendar is not a season statement; season left unset.
Pin 46.81180,-95.36330 is on the ballfield, ~140 m S of the RV loop; no move.
Note cleaned: dropped site counts, showers/restrooms and 'online booking available' (fields hold them) and 'Register at the municipal liquor store/city clerk' (no current source; booking is online).
